data.summary: Möbelhaus Beispielwohnen KG sent a second reminder (2. Mahnung) for the outstanding balance of €695.00 on a dining room furniture order (Auftrag BW-26-30871), asking for payment by 11 December 2026, after an earlier reminder of 4 November 2026 went unpaid.
data.explanation: This is a second reminder (2. Mahnung) for an unpaid furniture bill. You still owe €695.00 (the remaining €690.00 for the table and chairs plus €5.00 in reminder fees). The company asks that you pay the full amount by the stated due date. If you don't, they warn they will hand the claim over to a debt collection agency (Inkassounternehmen), and you would then also have to pay the collection costs. If you believe the amount is wrong or already paid, contact the seller directly; otherwise pay by the deadline shown to avoid extra costs.
